labels.shortDescription: Where Used error when the person lacks Manage BarnCRM Settings.
labels.value: You need the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission to see where a field is used.

labels.value: BarnCRM can't find the object {0} in this org.

labels.value: BarnCRM can't find the field {0} on {1}.

labels.value: Works on this kind of record

labels.shortDescription: Where Used: a filter condition names the field.
Where Used: a saved query sorts by the field.
Where Used: a related-records condition of a saved query names it.
Where Used: a related record column of a saved query names it.
Where Used: an import mapping matches records on the field.
Where Used: an import mapping links related records through the field.
Where Used: an import column loads the field. {0} is the file column heading.

Name shown for a private saved query. {0} is the owner's name.

labels.shortDescription: What breaks for a saved query when the field is deleted.
labels.value: Find refuses to run this query, and anything built on it, such as a segment, can't be counted or exported until it is edited.

labels.shortDescription: What breaks for a Super Transformer step list when the field is deleted.
labels.value: This step list can't be run until the step or filter that names the field is changed.

labels.shortDescription: What breaks for an import mapping when the field is deleted.
labels.value: Imports that use this mapping fail on this column or matching field until the mapping is edited.

labels.shortDescription: What breaks for a merge rule when the field is deleted.
labels.value: Auto-merge can't apply this rule until the rule is deleted in Duplicate Matching.

labels.shortDescription: What breaks for a matching source when the field is deleted.
labels.value: Duplicate matching can't read this source until it is edited or turned off.

labels.shortDescription: What breaks for a setting that lists the field when it is deleted.
labels.value: The setting skips the missing field; remove it from the list to keep the setting tidy.

labels.shortDescription: What breaks for a name or greeting pattern that reads the field.
labels.value: Names and greetings written from this pattern would leave this blank empty.

labels.shortDescription: What breaks for a setting whose chosen value is the field.
labels.value: The setting falls back to its default; choose another value before you delete the field.

labels.shortDescription: What breaks for a module record that names the field.
labels.value: This record stops working as set up (screening reads the field as blank, a computed indicator stops updating) until the part that names the field is changed.

labels.shortDescription: Row action and button that opens Where Used for a field.
Where Used window title. {0} is the field and object, or the object.
Where Used spinner text while it checks.
Where Used note on what it does not check; a Setup link follows.
labels.value: BarnCRM checks its own setup only. Flows, Apex code, page layouts, reports, list views, validation rules and formula fields are not checked: in Setup, use Where is this used? on the field for those.

labels.shortDescription: Where Used warning when a module's records could not be checked.
labels.value: Some module setup could not be checked. The Error Log has the details; check that module's setup by hand before you delete the field.

labels.shortDescription: Where Used result when nothing names the field.
labels.value: No BarnCRM setup uses this field.

labels.shortDescription: Where Used count. {0} is the number of setup records, more than one.
Where Used count for exactly one setup record.
Where in a setup record the field is named. {0} is a list of parts.
What stops working if the field is deleted. {0} is the explanation.
Button that switches Where Used to the whole object.
labels.value: Show Uses of the Whole Kind of Record

labels.shortDescription: Button that switches Where Used back to the one field.
Heading of the Retire a Field checklist.
Retire a Field step when no BarnCRM setup uses the field.
labels.value: No BarnCRM setup record needs changing.

labels.shortDescription: Retire a Field step for a field that cannot be deleted.
labels.value: This field can't be deleted: it is a standard field or a managed package installed it. Keep it hidden instead.
